description: This file defines a REST controller using Spring Boot annotations. It provides several endpoints including a welcome message, API documentation redirect, health check, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller that provides basic endpoints for a backend service, including welcome, documentation redirect, health check, and info endpoints.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message to indicate the service is running.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects to the Swagger UI documentation page, constructing the URL based on the incoming request and preserving scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Provides a health check endpoint returning 'OK'.
